title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.4 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 13.4 up to but not including 19.3.9, 19.4 up to but not including 19.4.8, and 19.5 up to but not including 19.5.6 allowed an authenticated user to view iteration details from private groups without proper authorization. This issue was due to missing authorization checks. The vulnerability has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
